name: Micro Credit Finance Scheme (MCF)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste (SC) entrepreneurs, small business owners, petty traders
description_en: Micro-finance credit assistance for small-scale income-generating activities such as petty shops, tea stalls, animal rearing, small artisans, and street vendors.
description_hi: छोटे पैमाने की आय-सृजन गतिविधियों जैसे चाय की दुकान, किराना दुकान, पशुपालन, दस्तकारी और फेरीवालों के लिए सूक्ष्म ऋण सहायता।

name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (MSY)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste (SC) Women Entrepreneurs and Self Help Groups (SHGs)
description_en: Special micro-credit empowerment scheme exclusively for SC women entrepreneurs offering highly subsidized loans with up to 95% project cost financing at just 4% p.a.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति की महिला उद्यमियों के लिए विशेष सूक्ष्म ऋण योजना, जिसमें 95% तक वित्तपोषण मात्र 4% वार्षिक रियायती ब्याज दर पर मिलता है।

name: Laghu Vyavasay Yojana (LVY)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals for small business and service units
description_en: Financial assistance for establishing or expanding small businesses, cottage industries, retail outlets, and service enterprises with loans up to ₹5.00 Lakhs at 6% p.a.
description_hi: लघु व्यवसाय, कुटीर उद्योग, खुदरा आउटलेट और सेवा उद्यमों के विस्तार हेतु ₹5.00 लाख तक का ऋण मात्र 6% वार्षिक दर पर।

name: NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste (SC) Entrepreneurs setting up commercially viable projects
description_en: Large-ticket credit assistance for medium enterprises, manufacturing plants, transport operations, service industries, and agricultural processing up to ₹50.00 Lakhs.
description_hi: मध्यम उद्यम, विनिर्माण संयंत्र, परिवहन वाहन, सेवा उद्योग और कृषि प्रसंस्करण के लिए ₹50 लाख तक का रियायती सावधि ऋण।
eligible_activities: flour mill oil mill agro processing
required_documents: Permits, licenses (Pollution, Trade, GST if applicable)

name: Educational Loan Scheme (ELS)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste (SC) Students pursuing higher technical or professional education
description_en: Low-interest educational loans up to ₹30 Lakhs (in India) and ₹40 Lakhs (abroad) for full-time professional/technical degrees (Engineering, Medical, MBA, MCA, Law).
description_hi: भारत में ₹30 लाख और विदेश में ₹40 लाख तक उच्च तकनीकी/व्यावसायिक पाठ्यक्रमों (इंजीनियरिंग, मेडिकल, एमबीए, कानून) के लिए 4% पर शैक्षणिक ऋण।
required_documents: Admission Offer Letter & Fee Schedule from Institution

name: Green Business Scheme (GBS)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste (SC) Entrepreneurs in eco-friendly and clean-energy sectors
description_en: Concessional loans for climate-mitigating clean technologies including Battery Electric Vehicles (e-rickshaws, e-autos), solar rooftop systems, polyhouses, and waste recycling.
description_hi: पर्यावरण-अनुकूल स्वच्छ तकनीकों जैसे ई-रिक्शा, ई-कार्ट, सोलर रूफटॉप प्लांट, पॉलीहाउस और कचरा पुनर्चक्रण के लिए रियायती ब्याज दर पर ऋण।

name: Swachhta Udyami Yojana (SUY)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementing_agency: National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation (NSKFDC / MoSJE)
target_beneficiary: Safai Karamcharis, Manual Scavengers, Liberated Sanitation Workers and Dependents
description_en: Financial assistance for procurement of mechanized cleaning and sanitation equipment (sewer jetting machines, suction emptiers, garbage compactor trucks, pay & use toilets).
description_hi: स्वचालित सफाई उपकरण जैसे सीवर जेटिंग मशीन, सक्शन एम्पटियर, कचरा ढोने वाले वाहन और सार्वजनिक शौचालय संचालन हेतु रियायती ऋण।
eligible_activities: sanitation pay and use toilet complex
required_documents: Machinery / Vehicle Quotation from authorized vendor

name: Stand-Up India Scheme (SC / ST / Women)
target_beneficiary: SC, ST, or Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield (first-time) enterprises
description_en: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield manufacturing, service, or agri-allied units.
description_hi: प्रति बैंक शाखा कम से कम एक एससी/एसटी और एक महिला को नई विनिर्माण, सेवा या व्यापार इकाई लगाने हेतु ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का बैंक ऋण।
required_documents: Pollution Control Board Consent & Udyam Registration

name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
name_hi: अनुसूचित जातियों के लिए वेंचर कैपिटल फंड (VCF-SC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_beneficiary: SC Promoted Tech Startups and High Growth Companies (min 51% SC shareholding)
description_en: Equity and concessional debt funding up to ₹5.00 Crores at 4% p.a. for innovative, scalable, technology-driven ventures with at least 51% SC equity ownership.
description_hi: कम से कम 51% अनुसूचित जाति स्वामित्व वाले अभिनव और तकनीकी स्टार्टअप के लिए ₹5 करोड़ तक का 4% वार्षिक दर पर वेंचर कैपिटल वित्तपोषण।

name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
implementing_agency: KVIC / State KVIB / District Industries Centres (DIC)
target_beneficiary: SC, ST, Women, Rural and Urban Micro-Entrepreneurs
description_en: Credit-linked subsidy programme providing up to 35% capital subsidy for SC/ST entrepreneurs setting up new micro manufacturing (up to 50L) or service (up to 20L) enterprises.
description_hi: ऋण-संबद्ध सब्सिडी योजना जो नए सूक्ष्म विनिर्माण (50 लाख तक) या सेवा उद्यम स्थापित करने वाले SC/ST उद्यमियों को 35% तक पूंजीगत अनुदान प्रदान करती है।

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Shishu Category
implementing_agency: MUDRA Ltd through Commercial Banks, RRBs, SFBs & MFIs
target_beneficiary: SC micro-enterprises, small shopkeepers, fruit vendors, service units
description_en: Zero-collateral micro credit up to ₹50,000 for early-stage micro-enterprises, vegetable sellers, roadside artisans, and small home businesses.
description_hi: प्रारंभिक चरण के सूक्ष्म उद्यमों, सब्जी विक्रेताओं, कारीगरों और छोटे गृह व्यवसायों के लिए ₹50,000 तक बिना किसी गारंटी के सूक्ष्म ऋण।

name: PM Street Vendor AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
name_hi: पीएम स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि (पीएम स्वनिधि)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
target_beneficiary: Urban and peri-urban street vendors, hawkers, petty artisans
description_en: Affordable working capital credit (₹10k in 1st tranche, ₹20k in 2nd, ₹50k in 3rd) with a 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment and digital cashback incentives.
description_hi: समय पर पुनर्भुगतान पर 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी और डिजिटल कैशबैक प्रोत्साहन के साथ किफायती कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण (पहले चरण में 10 हजार, दूसरे में 20 हजार, तीसरे में 50 हजार)।
required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Urban Local Body (ULB) Identity Card

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
target_beneficiary: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and basic tools
description_en: Holistic institutional support for 18 traditional trades offering ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, free skill training with stipend, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 Lakhs at 5% concessional interest.
description_hi: 18 पारंपरिक शिल्पों के लिए ₹15,000 टूलकिट प्रोत्साहन, वजीफे के साथ निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण और 5% रियायती ब्याज पर 3 लाख रुपये तक का संपार्श्विक-मुक्त उद्यम ऋण।

name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC Candidates (NOS)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
target_beneficiary: Scheduled Caste postgraduate and doctoral scholars studying abroad
description_en: Prestigious full scholarship grant covering 100% of international tuition fees, living allowances, airfare, and visa expenses for Master and Ph.D. degrees in premier overseas universities.
description_hi: शीर्ष विदेशी विश्वविद्यालयों में मास्टर और पीएचडी डिग्री के लिए अंतर्राष्ट्रीय ट्यूशन फीस, रहने का भत्ता, हवाई किराया और वीजा खर्च का 100% वहन करने वाली प्रतिष्ठित छात्रवृत्ति अनुदान।
required_documents: Unconditional Offer Letter from Top 500 QS Ranking University

name: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme for SCs (CEGSSC)
name_hi: अनुसूचित जातियों के लिए ऋण संवर्धन गारंटी योजना (CEGSSC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
implementing_agency: IFCI Ltd on behalf of Government of India
target_beneficiary: SC-owned companies, registered LLPs, and medium enterprises
description_en: Government guarantee cover providing 100% guarantee to Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) for business loans between ₹15 Lakhs and ₹5 Crores sanctioned to SC entrepreneurs.
description_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के उद्यमियों को स्वीकृत ₹15 लाख से ₹5 करोड़ के व्यावसायिक ऋणों के लिए सदस्य ऋणदाता संस्थाओं (एमएलआई) को 100% सरकारी गारंटी कवर।
required_documents: Proof of at least 51% SC equity ownership
